attchmntText: Pudumjee Paper Products Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 30, 2026, titled "PUDUMJEE REPORTS EBIDTA AT 21% FOR THE HALF YEAR ENDING 30.09.26".
Pudumjee Paper Products Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Pudumjee Paper Products Limited has informed the Exchange about Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

attchmntText: Significant increase in volume has been observed in Pudumjee Paper Products Limited.
